explanation: This tests double integrals defined by lower and upper Riemann sums, absent from the supplied Linear Algebra topics, so it is prerequisite. Telescoping gives (L+U)/2=(6²−5²)(3−1)−(3/2)(3²−1²)(6−5)=22−12=10 for every partition. Also U−L=ΣΣ(2Δx_i+3Δy_j)Δx_iΔy_j tends to zero as the mesh tends to zero. Thus both sums converge to 10.
